similarityReview: The 3D model accurately reconstructs the iconic blue-domed church of Santorini along with its adjacent pink bell tower. The main church features a cylindrical base with arched windows and a prominent blue hemispherical dome. The pink bell tower is modeled with multi-tiered arches, columns, and a small dome on top, matching the architectural details in the photo. All elements are anchored to a solid white base, ensuring watertight geometry and realistic proportions.
